hooks.text: 手绘中国民间传说被呈现成妖怪、奇迹与武术交织的动态水墨长卷
hooks.excerpt: Step into a hand-painted realm inspired by Chinese folklore — a living scroll of monsters, miracles, and martial arts.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 四名猎妖人分别围绕噬血诅咒刀、符箓火器、毒虫巫术和风火雷雨龙化构筑
hooks.excerpt: Mo San – A warrior from the Yao-Slaying Bureau, carrying a cursed blade thirsts blood. He channels his rage into raw power — but with every cut, the blade hungers more. How long before it devours him whole? Chuan – A Taoist with a bamboo-fire sword and a pouch full of dangerous inventions. He may look frail, but his bullets are blessed with talismanic magic. His homemade weapons "Bamboo Bombard" — turn spiritual alchemy into explosive justice. A-Zi – A prodigy witch from the southern Miao tribes, bonded with the poisons of the wild. She commands a legion of venomous insects and conjures ancient hexes passed down through bloodlines. To fight her is to fight the jungle itself. Ao Yu – A young dragon-descendant learning to command the storm. With mastery over wind, fire, thunder, and rain, she dances on the edge of control. But when her human form shatters... the dragon within awakens.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 卡池含400余张手工牌、172种内功和54类灵丹，并配套百余事件敌人与20层难度
hooks.excerpt: A Martial Fantasy Roguelike Rooted in Eastern Lore 400+ Handcrafted Cards 172 Inner Skills 54 Mystical Elixirs 100+ Random Events 100+ Unique Enemies 20 Ascending Difficulty Levels
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 手绘卡牌画面精致并能吸引玩家进入神秘世界。

excerpts.excerpt: The hand-painted visuals are stunning. Each card showcases intricate artwork that draws you into the mystical world.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 画风和绘画表现获得明确肯定。

excerpts.excerpt: 游戏好的是画风不错绘画好看
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 过度借鉴《杀戮尖塔》，导致多角色各玩一局后很快无聊

excerpts.excerpt: just used Slay too much as an anchor which ended up making it very boring after a single run with all 3 starting characters.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 角色卡池塞入过多不协同流派，导致卡池杂乱且难以找到需要的牌。

excerpts.excerpt: 不同流派的牌没啥配合，弹药的流派只能玩弹药，弃牌的流派里可以跨流派的用的也就一张过牌。就打起来很不舒服，总觉得卡池太杂了，找不到牌没有那种爽的感觉。
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 洗牌耗费行动力会惩罚小卡组

excerpts.excerpt: 光是洗牌要花一费就已经在惩罚小卡组
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 法力机制迫使玩家认真规划，而不是无脑连续出牌。

excerpts.excerpt: Yao-Guai Hunter's "mana" mechanic is quite cool, it forces you to think harder each time rather than simply spamming cards.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 成型后的多种卡组流派能带来很强爽感。

excerpts.excerpt: 游戏好的是画风不错绘画好看，牌组大成后是真的很爽
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 大卡组玩法也能较稳定通关，难度曲线平滑。

excerpts.excerpt: 这个游戏即便是大卡组也能较为稳定通关，难度曲线平滑
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 中国民间传说灵感为玩法提供了丰富背景氛围

excerpts.excerpt: The art style and inspiration from Chinese folklore provide a rich backdrop for the gameplay.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
